instruction.text: Look at the words below and decide whether they are adverbs or adverbial phrases of time, place or number.
Select the correct adverbial to link the paragraphs.

atoms.b:
Carl is baking a cake for his brother’s birthday party. He hasn’t made many cakes before, so he is following a recipe.

((++Firstly Finally Thirdly)), he needs to crack some eggs into a bowl. Secondly, he needs to add vanilla extract to the mix.

Harry is going to Greece. He is going to stay in Athens. Before he goes, he needs to pack some sun cream and enough clothes for five days.

((Next_year, ++In_the_shop, Behind_the_tree,)) he looked at all the different types of sun cream. He decided to buy the factor fifty sun cream.

Sophia plays chess for her school. She really enjoys playing chess and finds it very relaxing.

((At_home, ++Next_week, Last_week,)) she is going to compete in a national chess competition.

instruction.text: Select the correct word or phrase to link the paragraphs.

atoms.b:
Arlan does not enjoy reading. She finds it very boring and rarely reads outside of school.

((++On_the_other_hand Moreover)), Max loves to read. He carries a book with him everywhere that he goes.

My uncle is planning a surprise party for my aunt. He has lots to do before the event. Most importantly, he needs to book a venue.

((++In_addition However)), he needs to organise catering and invitations.

instruction.text: Choose the matching sentence to form the most cohesive paragraph using repetition.

atoms.a: Mohammad enjoys arts and crafts. He makes lots of different things, such as birthday cards and calendars.
atoms.b: Mohammad also enjoys running. He goes running every weekend.

atoms.a: Wendy is going to the gym. Today, she is going to use the treadmill to train for a half-marathon.
atoms.b: Wendy has been going to the gym regularly for about six months. She joined the gym because it became too cold to run outdoors.
